claims.assertion: Mari says reincarnation need not follow Earth’s chronology: souls may enter a body in the apparent past or inhabit overlapping lives.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes this to time being perceived differently beyond Earth’s system.

claims.assertion: Mari says planetary systems can have different time rates, creating synchronization problems she calls time slippage; muon gravity-pulse transmissions exposed the differences.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the transmissions are virtually instantaneous.
